executive_summary:
Episode 35 centers on a read-aloud anonymous insider email that alleges the Egyptian military aircraft tail number SUBTT made repeated, multi-day stops in Wilmington, Delaware because of federal activity at 920 North King Street, a building the email identifies as housing the FBI, DEA, and Secret Service. The host anchors the email's premises to a series of displayed/linked artifacts: the host's compiled flight-pattern chart for SUBTT, a 1997 DOJ directory reference, a December 2024 SATIDS (French aircraft finishing company) announcement regarding the Wilmington hangar, a DRBA January 2024 resolution, and an FBI December 5, 2024 press release. She claims to have vetted the tip with contacts at federal agencies and the State Department.

The second evidentiary strand introduces a documentary contradiction within TPUSA's own post-event statements: Frank Turek's Megyn Kelly interview (A-1441) describing Charlie's team operating drones is presented against Brian Harpole's Shawn Ryan interview (A-1442) stating no drones were used. The episode also documents Harpole's repetition of the "3,000 lbs of energy" bullet-trajectory claim and includes read/played clips of Joe Rogan / Theo Von discussing conspiracies and Tim Pool regarding his exclusion from AmFest.

Structurally, the episode introduces Wilmington, Delaware as a new investigative geography and elevates the insider-email-vetting process as a methodological development in the series.

claims.label: Host Says SUBTT Departed Provo 7:14 AM and Arrived Wilmington 11:51 AM ET on September 10, 2025
claims.claim: The host says the yellow Egyptian government jet (tail number SUBTT) departed Provo, Utah at 7:14 AM local on September 10, 2025 and arrived Wilmington, Delaware at 11:51 AM Eastern.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference host's timeline against independent ADS-B / FlightAware historical data for September 10, 2025.

claims.label: Host Says SUBTT Stayed Overnight in Wilmington Until September 11 at 7:56 AM
claims.claim: The host says the Egyptian plane remained in Wilmington, Delaware overnight and departed September 11, 2025 at 7:56 AM, which she says rules out a fuel-stop explanation.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify overnight ground time via independent flight tracking and Wilmington airport records.

claims.label: Anonymous Email the Host Reads Says SUBTT Made Multi-Day Wilmington Stays in November 2022
claims.claim: Per an anonymous email the host reads, SUBTT flew Cairo–Paris–Wichita–Wilmington–Cairo on November 13, 2022, then returned to Wilmington on November 17, 2022 and remained until November 20, 2022 before returning to Cairo.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against independent historical ADS-B / FAA records for tail number SUBTT in November 2022.

claims.label: Host Reads Email Saying June 1997 DOJ Directory Lists Wilmington Resident Office at 920 King Street, Suite 404
claims.claim: Per an anonymous email the host reads, and which the host says her team confirmed, a June 1997 Department of Justice directory (page titled 675) lists a Wilmington Resident Office at 1 Rodney Square, Suite 404, 920 King Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the cited DOJ directory and confirm page 675 directly; compare against current DOJ directory listings.

claims.label: Host Says 920 North King Street Currently Houses DEA, FBI, and Secret Service
claims.claim: The host says current public directories show DEA, FBI, and U.S. Secret Service all listed at 920 North King Street, Suite 404, Wilmington, Delaware, with phone numbers published.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via direct lookups of each agency's published Wilmington field office directory entries; cross-check Google business listings.

claims.label: Host Says SATIDS Announced December 2024 Takeover of Wilmington Airport Hangar
claims.claim: The host says a French aircraft finishing company, SATIDS, announced in December 2024 it was taking over the shuttered Wilmington airport hangar (formerly a Dassault Falcon authorized center), investing approximately $1M+, and says her team confirmed this.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate SATIDS press release and Delaware outlet coverage; confirm date and dollar figure.

claims.label: Per Document Host Reads, DRBA January 2024 Resolution Authorized Paint Hanger Lease to SATIDS
claims.claim: Per a Delaware River and Bay Authority (DRBA) January 2024 resolution the host reads, the DRBA was acquiring rights to a paint hangar formerly part of a Dassault leasehold and authorizing execution of a lease with SATIDS.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the DRBA resolution document directly from DRBA public records.

claims.label: Per FBI Press Release Host Reads, Wray Cited Partnerships in Wilmington December 2024
claims.claim: Per an FBI press release dated December 5, 2024 that the host reads, Director Christopher Wray emphasized "key partners" and described partnerships as closer than 5 or 10 years prior.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and review the FBI press release directly; verify quoted phrases and date.

claims.label: Frank Turek Stated Charlie's Team Had Drones Operating at the Event
claims.claim: Frank Turek, on the Megyn Kelly Show, stated that on the day of the event, Charlie's team had drones up looking at the crowd from above and texted him video footage during the drive-in.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Megyn Kelly / Frank Turek interview clip and timestamp; confirm exact wording.

claims.label: Brian Harpole Stated TPUSA Did Not Have Drones at the Event
claims.claim: Brian Harpole, on the Shawn Ryan interview, stated TPUSA did not have drones at the event because he "wasn't allowed to have drones."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Shawn Ryan / Brian Harpole interview clip and timestamp; confirm exact wording.

claims.label: Brian Harpole Repeated the 3,000 lbs of Energy Bullet-Trajectory Description
claims.claim: Brian Harpole, on the Shawn Ryan interview, repeated the bullet-trajectory description involving entry, C6 vertebra crush, and 3,000 lbs of energy.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full interview clip; confirm exact wording and timestamps.

claims.label: Tim Pool Characterized Candace Owens's Podcast Narrative as "Conspiracy Drama"
claims.claim: Tim Pool stated in a video that the narrative from the number one podcast had turned into "conspiracy drama about Charlie Kirk if Turning Point was involved in it," with references to "Jewish donors pulling out" and "Erika knew everything."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Tim Pool's original video and timestamp the quoted language.

claims.label: Tim Pool Stated He Was Told He Could Not Come to AmFest
claims.claim: Tim Pool stated in a video that he had been told he couldn't come to AmFest, speculating it might be due to his statements on funding Israel and giving money to Ukraine.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Tim Pool's original video and confirm AmFest / Afest naming and exact quoted language.

claims.label: Joe Rogan and Theo Von Asserted Conspiracies Are Real and Common
claims.claim: On The Joe Rogan Experience, Joe Rogan and Theo Von stated that conspiracies are real, common, and especially effective when conducted by people in positions of extreme power running intelligence agencies.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific Rogan episode by number and date; preserve timestamp of the cited segment.

claims.label: Tip Arrived Before Host Linked Egyptian Planes to Erika and Charlie
claims.claim: The host says the government-linked person who sent the Wilmington tip sent it before she had figured out that the Egyptian planes were tracking Erika and Charlie.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original email with its received date and compare it with the first episode in which the host tied the Egyptian planes to Erika Kirk and Charlie Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: this individual who works with or for government sent it before I had figured out that the Egyptian planes were tracking Erika and Charlie.

claims.label: Host Says SUBTT Repeatedly Stayed Days in Delaware
claims.claim: The host says the yellow Egyptian jet, tail number SUBTT, kept stopping in Wilmington, Delaware, sometimes for days, and that Wilmington is not a normal routing hub for private or public travel.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the full SUBTT flight history from independent ADS-B and FAA sources and count Wilmington stops and ground times.
claims.transcript_snippet: the yellow jet tail number SUBTT which kept overlaying sometimes even for days in Delaware.

claims.label: Plane Departing Provo on Sept 10 Was the One That Brought the Egyptians Six Days Earlier
claims.claim: The host says the yellow plane that left Provo on the morning of the assassination was the same plane that had initially carried over the 12 or 14 Egyptians six days earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the September 4 Provo arrival record for SUBTT with the September 10 departure record to confirm it is the same airframe and passenger count.
claims.transcript_snippet: the plane that had initially carried over the 12 or 14 quote unquote unquote Egyptians six days earlier, that plane departed, the yellow plane departed on the morning at 7:14 a. m. local time from Provo, Utah

claims.label: Wilmington Landing About 2.5 Hours Before the Shooting
claims.claim: The host says SUBTT landed in Wilmington at 11:51 a.m. Eastern, about 9:51 a.m. Utah time, roughly two and a half hours before Charlie Kirk was shot at 12:23 Utah time.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the SUBTT wheels-down time at Wilmington against the shooting time established in the official timeline.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie's going to get shot at 12:23. This plane has landed into Wilmington at what would be 9:51 a. m. So about 2 and 1 half hours before Charlie is shot.

claims.label: Host Says Tip Was Confirmed by Federal Agency and State Department Contacts
claims.claim: The host says the emailer challenged her to check with people in federal agencies and at the State Department, that she did so after waiting a while, and that those people confirmed what the email said.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to identify the agencies and offices consulted, or have independent sources with access to the same agencies test the email's premises.
claims.transcript_snippet: people that were working in federal agencies and people that work at the State Department to confirm what he had said. And I did.

claims.label: Host Says Tip Was Vetted to the Highest Levels of Government
claims.claim: The host says her team took time vetting the tip and that it was vetted across multiple government agencies and to the highest levels of government, so she considers it legitimate and not a distraction.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the names, roles or agencies of the vetting sources, or independent corroboration of the email's central claims.
claims.transcript_snippet: We vetted it across multiple government agencies and to really the highest levels of government. So, this is legit.

claims.label: Email Says Maintenance Was Not the Reason for SUBTT Wilmington Stops
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying that claims SUBTT stopped at Wilmington for just maintenance are not true and that the information will implicate the FBI and various other government agencies.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Wilmington airport and hangar service records for SUBTT and compare with the flight timeline.
claims.transcript_snippet: Some people may tell you that SUBTT stopped at Wilmington because it was quote unquote just maintenance. That is not true.

claims.label: Email Says Non-Public Movement Data Was Empty, Implying a Diplomatic Arrival
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying the writer tried to pull non-public movement data on the September 10 arrival and found nothing, which the writer takes to mean the arrival was processed under a diplomatic and dignitary category.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask CBP, FAA and Wilmington airport authorities how diplomatic arrivals are logged and whether SUBTT's September 10 arrival appears.
claims.transcript_snippet: I tried to pull non-public movement data and it came up empty for me. This means that the arrival was processed under a diplomatic and dignitary category

claims.label: Email Says an Unnamed Entity Uses Vehicles at the Airport for Covert Handoffs
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying the writer can confirm that a redacted entity uses vehicles that often enter and leave the Wilmington airport during covert handoffs, a point the writer says the host cannot verify directly.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the redacted entity from the original email and seek airport gate logs or vehicle access records.
claims.transcript_snippet: I can confirm that blank uses vehicles which often leave and enter that airport when they do covert handoffs.

claims.label: Email Says Only Federal Vehicles Can Access Private Gates for Government Planes
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying that only federal vehicles are allowed access to private gates housing government planes, and that government vehicles pick up, monitor or escort every government plane that lands there.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Wilmington airport security and tenant rules on gate access for foreign government aircraft.
claims.transcript_snippet: Government vehicles either pick up, monitor, or escort every government plane that lands there.

claims.label: Email Says Vehicles Tied to 920 North King Street Arrived and Left in SUBTT's Window
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying the writer can guarantee that vehicles affiliated with the 920 North King Street workspace arrived and left inside the same window as SUBTT.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek airport gate logs, camera footage or witness statements for vehicle movements at SUBTT's Wilmington arrival on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: I can guarantee you that the vehicles affiliated with this workspace arrived and left inside the same window as SUBTT.

claims.label: Email Says Federal Vehicles Pass Through King Street
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying nearly every federal vehicle that visits the airport passes through King Street at least once because that is where most such vehicles are stationed.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the fleet and parking arrangements at 920 North King Street through public records and building tenant information.
claims.transcript_snippet: Nearly every federal vehicle that visits the airport will pass through King Street at least once because that is where the majority of the vehicles are ultimately stationed.

claims.label: Email Says Vehicles Swap Diplomatic Plates for Local Plates
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying that, to avoid tying assets to the government, vehicles most likely swapped diplomatic plates for local ones while keeping federal clearance, and that the fleet is federal, unmarked or local.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek Delaware DMV or toll-camera plate records for vehicles at the airport on September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: they most likely immediately swapped the plates for local, but they still had federal clearance.

claims.label: Email Says a Meeting Not in a Car Took Place With SUBTT
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying that sometimes a meeting needs a more convenient spot than a car and that this is what happened with SUBTT.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for any record of where SUBTT passengers went after landing, such as hotel, ground transport or building access logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: a meeting that's not in a car. That is what I am telling you happened with SUBTT.

claims.label: Email Says No Evidence Can Be Shown but Insiders Would Confirm
claims.claim: The host reads the email acknowledging the writer cannot show evidence such as dash cam or camera footage, but saying it is known among insiders and that intel insiders would confirm it.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek on-record or documentary confirmation from any insider named in the email chain; treat the claim as unverified until then.
claims.transcript_snippet: this is known among insiders. And if you want confirmation, you can ask intel insiders of yours and they will confirm that that is exactly what happened.

claims.label: Host Says Secret Service's 2025 Field Office List Still Shows Wilmington
claims.claim: The host says, citing the email, that the Secret Service's own 2025 field office list still shows Wilmington, Delaware, and that the DEA and Secret Service are both listed at Suite 404, 920 North King Street, with phone numbers.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the Secret Service 2025 field office list and the DEA directory entry for Wilmington and compare addresses and suite numbers.
claims.transcript_snippet: In the Secret Service case, the AY's own 2025 field office list still shows Wilmington, Delaware.

claims.label: Host Says the 1990s DOJ Suites Evolved Into a Multi-Agency Space
claims.claim: The host says the suites the Department of Justice held in the 1990s never went away and eventually evolved into a multi-agency space in a commercial building.
claims.investigative_direction: Review GSA lease and building tenant records for 920 North King Street from 1997 to date.
claims.transcript_snippet: That means the suites that the Department of Justice owned in the '90s never actually went away. This eventually evolved into a multi- agency space in a commercial building.

claims.label: Host Compares 920 North King Street to 33 Thomas Street
claims.claim: The host says 920 North King Street looks like a mini version of the 33 Thomas Street building in New York, the building she says is associated with the Snowden leak, with glass windows as the only difference.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare photographs of both buildings; the resemblance has no bearing on tenancy.
claims.transcript_snippet: It looks exactly like a mini version of the thing. The only difference is that 920 North King has glass windows.

claims.label: Host Says X Users Cited a Falcon Maintenance Arrangement Dating to 1999
claims.claim: The host says people on X argued SUBTT has an alibi because it aligns with a longstanding Falcon maintenance arrangement out of Wilmington dating back to 1999.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original X posts and any documentation of a Falcon maintenance arrangement at Wilmington.
claims.transcript_snippet: SUBTT has an alibi because it quote unquote aligns with a longstanding Falcon maintenance arrangement out of Wilmington that dates back to 1999.

claims.label: Host Says the Wilmington Dassault Falcon Center Shut Down Around 2021
claims.claim: The host says Wilmington used to have a Dassault Falcon authorized service center but it shut down around 2021, before the 2024 SATIDS announcement.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the closure date through Dassault Falcon service-center listings and Wilmington airport tenant records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Wilmington used to have a Dissult Falcon authorized center but it shut down around 2021.

claims.label: Email Says DRBA Operates on Federally Regulated Waterways With a Chain to the President
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying the Delaware River and Bay Authority operates on federally regulated waterways and that its chain of authority runs through the Army Corps of Engineers, the Secretary of the Army and the Secretary of Defense to the President.
claims.investigative_direction: Review DRBA's enabling compact and federal oversight to test whether its airport lease decisions fall under any federal chain of authority.
claims.transcript_snippet: The chain here that would report from the people who control the rivers would be DRBA to the Army Corps of Engineers, the Secretary of the Army and the Secretary of Defense to the President.

claims.label: Email Says SUBTT Traveled to France Before the SATIDS Deal Existed
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying SUBTT's timeline shows it traveled to France before the SATIDS deal was made, so a 2024 French finishing lease cannot explain a long-running Wilmington routine, and calls the maintenance story a cover.
claims.investigative_direction: Line up SUBTT's France stops and Wilmington stops against the January 2024 DRBA resolution and December 2024 SATIDS announcement.
claims.transcript_snippet: your own timeline shows how they traveled to France before the deal was even made. It proves that the maintenance story is nothing but a cover.

claims.label: Email Says Google Lists 920 North King Street as FBI Versus the Public Address
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying a Google search for the FBI Wilmington Resident Agency will likely show 920 North King Street labeled Federal Bureau of Investigation, rather than the public FBI address at 500 Delaware Avenue, Suite 300.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive current and historical Google Business and FBI field office listings for both Wilmington addresses.
claims.transcript_snippet: you will likely get 920 North King Street with the label Federal Bureau of Investigation instead of the public FBI address that's at 500 Delaware Avenue, Sweet 300

claims.label: Email Says the Site Is a Joint DOJ and DHS Location With Three Agencies
claims.claim: The host reads the email saying that because the Secret Service is part of Homeland Security rather than Justice, 920 North King Street looks like a joint DOJ and DHS site that verifiably houses three agencies and possibly more, and that the writer knows of no other such location.
